_doc: Risk tiers for the Merge gate check and for land_pr.py. The tier is set by the change, not by who wrote it.

dan: waits for Dan. The Merge gate check fails until the repository owner adds the approved_label. low: only prose and images. normal: everything else. The gate passes low and normal; land_pr.py also wants an independent review line for normal.
Globs: ** crosses folders, * and ? stay inside one folder. A rename is judged by both its old and new path.

Per repo: dan adds stop-list paths; low_heads names automation branches whose workflow-opened PRs are low; no_ci_ok lets land_pr.py land a PR when the repo's path-filtered CI doesn't run for it; own_gate leaves stop-list PRs to the repo's own merge job.
This file and merge_gate.py are on the stop list of this repository, so a PR can't loosen the rules that judge it.

dfakkeldy/merge-gate.note: This repository is the gate. Every repo runs its main branch, so a change here changes the rule everywhere.
